title: Ubudiah Mosque
geometryBasis: Native mosque envelope, Tourism Malaysia and the Islamic Tourism Centre architectural descriptions, and matching day and night exterior photographs.
sectionBasis: The landmark’s onion dome, smaller domed turrets, four slender minarets with banded stone shafts and pointed white arcades are distinct in the source photographs.
limitations: The standing worship building with the attached entry and four major minarets. Detached service blocks, cemetery and site furnishings are outside scope.
Precise minaret heights, cornice details and side bays are estimated from the public-domain photographs.
